messages:
maya: FYI planning v2 rollout tonight 01:30 UTC. Noticed a client header bug in older mobile SDKs that can drop X-Api-Version on empty responses. Could cause silent non-opt-in.

lee: which tenants?

sam: telemetry flagged: tenant:acme-corp, tenant:fastpay, tenant:playzone. low QPS but mobile-heavy.

maya: plan: pin those three to v1 during the window and add a short-lived proxy probe metric `header_missing.count` by tenant. If probe >5 for 5m, pause shift.

ops: will add probe + Grafana tile and set an alert to page oncall if any tenant >5 for 5m. ETA 20m.

maya: rollback/runbook: pause and unpin if 15m client 5xx >2% OR p95 latency +300ms OR deploy-bot reports >10% canary failures.

sam: I'll update release notes and call out SDK <3.1. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2790

lee: deploy-bot commands?

maya: `/deploybot pin tenant:acme-corp v1 --until 2026-04-02T05:00Z` (repeat for fastpay, playzone)

deploy-bot: pinned tenants: acme-corp, fastpay, playzone (expires 2026-04-02T05:00Z).

maya: schedule: start 2026-04-01T01:30Z ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m checks. Operators: @ops for first 45m, i'll be monitoring.

ops: all set. will post when job starts and if alerts fire.

maya: thanks — keeping channel open during window.
